scope: Keep the retained heroic jewelry loot while limiting its generated gameplay authority to one Publish 14.1 weapon-speed skill modifier and migrating the exact NGE primary-stat and weapon action-cost leaves previously written to persisted items.

findings: Publish 14.1 attack cadence sums the weapon template's category speed modifiers plus the authored private and generic melee/ranged speed modifiers; it has no weapon action-cost expertise statistic.

The authenticated Publish 12 client skill table contains the classic weapon speed families and none of agility_modified, stamina_modified, constitution_modified, precision_modified, strength_modified, or luck_modified; the extracted patch exposes twenty-three classic skill-buff assets and none for those six later primary stats.
The restored x64 command queue maps the ten retained jewelry categories to their authenticated Publish 14.1 *_speed modifiers and consumes the enhanced modifier in calculatePrecuAttackTime.

The inherited heroic jewelry generator produced two NGE primary-stat modifiers plus expertise_action_weapon_<type>; those statistics feed later combat mechanics and have no authenticated one-to-one Publish 14.1 jewelry translation.

All twenty-six jewelry definitions and all seventy-two heroic loot-table placements remain. New items write only one weighted PRE-CU speed modifier, while attach, initialize, and delayed generation remove the exact sixteen legacy NGE leaves without deleting unrelated skillmod leaves or rerolling an already-valid speed modifier.

buildEvidence.sourceTest: passed; one PRE-CU speed writer, zero NGE writers, exact six-primary and ten-action migration leaves, leaf-only cleanup, idempotent preservation, unchanged weighting/value, all twenty-six master-item bindings, all seventy-two heroic loot placements, skill-table definitions, and native cadence consumption
buildEvidence.focusedJavaCompile: passed with Java 11 in an ephemeral in-memory directory removed immediately after inspection; bytecode contains the speed-only writer, exact migration arrays, leaf removal, idempotent speed detection, and all ten PRE-CU speed modifiers

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: Retained heroic jewelry no longer writes NGE primary stats or weapon action-cost expertise. Existing items migrate those exact persisted leaves and gain a weighted PRE-CU speed modifier only when they do not already have one.
auditBoundary.preserved: All jewelry templates, names, item-table rows, heroic loot placements, delayed generation, the +2 speed magnitude, the original ranged/melee/lightsaber weighting, existing valid speed rolls, and unrelated skillmod leaves remain unchanged.
